title: Souja Loader Open Source Script Hub Loader
features:
Key Features of Souja Hub

Souja Hub is a powerful and modern script loader designed to provide a seamless, reliable, and visually appealing user experience.

✨ Sleek & Dynamic User Interface

Modern Animated UI: Enjoy a clean and professional interface with smooth animations for every element, powered by TweenService.

Remote Theming Engine: The entire look and feel can be changed on the fly. The loader fetches themes from an online source, allowing for endless customization without needing to update the script.

Audio Visualizer: The UI border dynamically pulses and reacts to in-game sounds, creating a cool, immersive visual effect.

Customizable Sounds: Experience satisfying audio feedback for actions like opening, success, failure, and status updates.

🚀 Intelligent & Robust Loading

Automatic Game Detection: The hub intelligently detects which game you are playing and automatically loads the correct script for it.

Universal Fallback Script: If you're in an unsupported game, it seamlessly loads a universal script so you're never left without options.

Reliable Downloads: Features a robust HTTP request system that automatically retries failed downloads, ensuring scripts and assets load correctly even on unstable connections.

🔧 User-Friendly & Informative

Live Update Notifier: Automatically checks for new versions and displays a clean "Update Available!" message, so you always know you're on the latest version.

In-Loader Changelog: A "What's New?" button lets you view the latest updates and changes directly inside the loader UI.

Helpful Tips & Status Updates: The loader keeps you informed with clear status messages and occasionally displays helpful tips during the loading process.

Easy Error Reporting: If something goes wrong, the loader displays a clear error message and a one-click "[Copy Error]" button for easy troubleshooting and support.

⚙️ Powerful Remote Management

Remote "Kill-Switch": Developers can remotely disable the loader for maintenance via a status file, displaying a custom message to all users.

Optional Whitelist System: The script includes a built-in whitelist system that can be enabled to restrict access to specific users.
